name: Helga
source: A descendant of the Ale tribe from the east. Although Helga is from the same tribe as [url=/c96491]Rene Fortuna[/url] and [url=/c96500]Elena[/url], she bears a strong hatred for both of them for some reason. She has very strong magic powers and unlike Rene, can fully control them. Helga is awe-inspiring in Erectus, where magic is less developed, and her subordinates are all monsters.
